title: GPU-Enabled Large-Scale Optimization Using Randomized Linear Algebra
abstract: arXiv:2609.08136v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces rlaopt, a PyTorch-based package for large-scale optimization and scientific computing using randomized numerical linear algebra (RandNLA). Despite substantial progress in RandNLA-based algorithms, few implementations combine GPU acceleration with a simple interface for specifying optimization problems. rlaopt addresses this gap by providing GPU-enabled solvers for positive-definite linear systems and convex empirical risk minimization with constraints and regularizers. These solvers use RandNLA to accelerate conjugate gradient (NystromPCG), operator splitting (NysADMM), and stochastic gradient methods (SAPPHIRE). Moreover, rlaopt includes a modeling language that lets users specify problems using natural mathematical syntax. rlaopt automatically checks compatibility with the selected solver and performs the required problem decomposition. translated_title: 基于随机化线性代数的GPU加速大规模优化
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了 rlaopt，一个基于 PyTorch 的软件包，用于借助随机化数值线性代数进行大规模优化和科学计算。尽管基于 RandNLA 的算法已取得长足进展，但很少有实现能够将 GPU 加速与简洁的优化问题定义接口相结合。rlaopt 填补了这一空白，它为正定线性系统以及带约束和正则化项的凸经验风险最小化问题提供了支持 GPU 的求解器。这些求解器利用 RandNLA 来加速共轭梯度法（NystromPCG）、算子分裂法（NysADMM）以及随机梯度方法（SAPPHIRE）。此外，rlaopt 还包含一种建模语言，允许用户使用自然的数学语法来描述问题。rlaopt 会自动检查问题与所选求解器的兼容性，并执行所需的问题分解。这些求解器还支持对其迭代过程进行自动微分，从而支持（后文内容被截断）……
tldr: rlaopt 是一个基于 PyTorch 的软件包，通过将随机化数值线性代数与 GPU 加速相结合，为大规模正定线性系统和带约束正则化的凸优化问题提供高效求解器，并配备自然数学语法的建模语言和可微分迭代功能。
en_tdlr: rlaopt is a PyTorch-based package that combines randomized numerical linear algebra with GPU acceleration to efficiently solve large-scale positive-definite linear systems and constrained, regularized convex optimization problems, featuring a natural-math-syntax modeling language and differentiable solver iterations.
